data.body: Reviewer false positives on fix: dso:code-reviewer-standard claimed (1) verify-session-provenance.sh has 246 lines and no PR_NUMBER reference, (2) test-verify-session-provenance-cases.sh does not exist. Empirical evidence: script is 444 lines on main (post-PR-#259 merge); PR_NUMBER referenced at lines 186, 369 (deployed code); layered filter at lines 339-414; test file present and 13/13 tests pass. Reviewer appears to have reviewed against a stale/incorrect tree. R5 defense (false positive — reviewer hallucinated). Proceeding with commit.
